rationale: Largest Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow (450 drones, two deaths) represents a qualitative escalation in the war next door, raising regional security concerns. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
top_events.label: Ukraine fires 450 drones at Moscow region
top_events.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow, with 450 drones downed and two deaths reported. This escalation in deep-strike capability raises regional security concerns for Poland.

top_events.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
top_events.label: US Denmark sign Greenland security agreement
top_events.summary: Denmark and the US reached a Greenland security agreement after months of Trump threats. NATO welcomed the deal, which Trump claims gives permanent US control.

top_events.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
top_events.label: Houthis strike Riyadh airport fuel depot
top_events.summary: Houthi ballistic missiles struck a fuel depot at Riyadh airport, causing delays. Saudi Arabia reports shooting down a missile aimed at the capital.

short_summary: Ukraine drones strike Moscow oil refinery

most_significant_event.label: Ukraine drones strike Moscow oil refinery
most_significant_event.summary: Ukrainian drones hit Moscow region oil refinery, killing two people. Moscow claims 450 drones downed in unprecedented attack, marking escalation in war on Poland's eastern border.
